supertack_plate_temp.label: Other layers
supertack_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature (degC) after the first layer on the Bambu Cool Plate SuperTack, per filament. The plate grips at low temperatures: ~35 for PLA; 0 disables heating. Too hot causes elephant foot and over-adhesion; plate unsuited to high-temp materials.

cool_plate_temp.label: Other layers
cool_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature, C, for layers after the first on the Cool Plate build surface. Plate-specific counterpart to hot/textured/engineering plate temps. 35 C typical for PLA; exceeding the plate's rating degrades its coating.

eng_plate_temp.label: Other layers
eng_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature (deg C) for layers after the first when the Engineering Plate is selected. Per filament. Higher resists warping; too high softens lower layers and worsens elephant foot. 0 disables bed heating for those layers.

hot_plate_temp.label: Other layers
hot_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature in C for layers after the first when printing on the Smooth PEI / High Temp plate. Material-dependent: ~45-60 PLA, ~65-80 PETG, ~90-110 ABS/ASA. Too high softens lower layers; too low risks warping. Per-filament.

textured_plate_temp.label: Other layers
textured_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature (deg C) on the Textured PEI plate for layers after the first, per filament. Higher improves adhesion but can soften lower layers; lower eases release. Textured plates often need ~5-10 deg more than smooth plates.

supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer
supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: First-layer bed temperature (degC) on the Bambu Cool Plate SuperTack, per filament. Usually equal to or slightly above the later-layer temperature; ~35 for PLA; 0 disables heating. Plate unsuited to high-temp materials.

cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer
cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: First-layer bed temperature, C, on the Cool Plate surface. Slightly higher than later layers can aid adhesion; Cool Plate is designed for low-temp printing (PLA), so values stay near 35 C.

eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer
eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: First-layer bed temperature (deg C) on the Engineering Plate. Governs initial adhesion; vendor profiles often match the other-layers plate temp. 0 disables heating for the first layer.

hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer
hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: First-layer bed temperature in C on the Smooth PEI / High Temp plate. Often equal to or 5 C above later layers to maximize adhesion. Per-filament.

textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer
textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: Bed temperature (deg C) on the Textured PEI plate for the first layer, per filament. Slightly higher than later layers aids initial adhesion into the texture; too high causes glossy squish and elephant foot. PLA ~45-65, PETG ~65-80 typical.

enable_overhang_bridge_fan.label: Force cooling for overhang and bridge
enable_overhang_bridge_fan.description: Forces the part-cooling fan to the overhang fan speed on overhangs and bridges, bypassing layer-time fan logic. Firms up sagging-prone extrusions. Disable for filaments where extra cooling breaks layer adhesion (ABS/ASA/PC).

overhang_fan_speed.label: Fan speed for overhang
overhang_fan_speed.description: Part-cooling fan speed (%) forced on overhang walls and bridges, overriding the normal min/max fan range. Higher freezes overhang lines faster, reducing sag and curl; for warp-prone high-temp materials (ABS) keep moderate. Default 100.

ironing_fan_speed.label: Ironing fan speed
ironing_fan_speed.description: Part cooling fan speed during ironing, percent (0-100). Lower keeps the surface molten longer for better smoothing; higher prevents heat buildup on small tops. -1 leaves fan at the normal setting for the layer. Per-filament vector.

pre_start_fan_time.label: Pre start fan time
pre_start_fan_time.description: Seconds to issue the fan speed command ahead of an overhang or bridge region so the fan physically spins up before the lines print. Raise (up to 5 s) for fans with slow response; 0 changes fan speed exactly at the feature.

overhang_fan_threshold.label: Cooling overhang threshold
overhang_fan_threshold.description: Overhang ratio (per extruder position) above which the part-cooling fan is forced to its overhang speed. Expressed as line-width overhang percentage; 0% cools every line, 95% only near-bridges. Lower thresholds improve overhang surfaces on heat-sensitive materials like PLA; keep high for warp-prone ABS.

overhang_threshold_participating_cooling.label: Overhang threshold for participating cooling
overhang_threshold_participating_cooling.description: Overhang ratio above which lines count toward layer-time cooling calculations (per extruder position). At 100% only bridges participate; lower values make overhanging lines trigger slowdown-for-cooling earlier. Tune together with overhang_fan_threshold.

compatible_printers.label: Compatible machine
compatible_printers.description: List of printer profile names this preset applies to. Empty = compatible with all. Metadata for preset filtering, not print behavior.

compatible_printers_condition.label: Compatible machine condition
compatible_printers_condition.description: Boolean expression over printer config values (e.g. nozzle_diameter, printer_model) gating whether this preset is offered for a printer. Empty = always compatible. Metadata, no print effect.

compatible_prints.label: Compatible process profiles
compatible_prints.description: List of process (print) profile names this filament preset applies to. Empty = all. Metadata for preset filtering.

compatible_prints_condition.label: Compatible process profiles condition
compatible_prints_condition.description: Boolean expression over process config values gating whether this filament preset is offered with a given process profile. Empty = always. Metadata, no print effect.

slow_down_for_layer_cooling.label: Slow printing down for better layer cooling
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.description: Enables automatic slowdown on layers finishing faster than slow_down_layer_time, letting each layer solidify before the next. Per filament. Essential for small parts in PLA/PETG; disable when slowdown causes heat soak or timing matters more.

no_slow_down_for_cooling_on_outwalls.label: Don't slow down outer walls
no_slow_down_for_cooling_on_outwalls.description: Exempts outer walls from the automatic layer-time cooling slowdown. Keeps outer wall speed uniform so surface sheen stays consistent; risks sagging on small or short layers since cooling relies on fan alone. Off by default.

cooling_slowdown_logic.label: Cooling slowdown logic
cooling_slowdown_logic.description: Strategy used when layer time falls below the cooling threshold: 'uniform_cooling' slows the whole layer evenly, 'consistent_surface' preserves outer-wall speed for a uniform sheen and slows other features harder. Per extruder position.

cooling_perimeter_transition_distance.label: Perimeter transition distance
cooling_perimeter_transition_distance.description: Distance, mm, over which fan speed blends when perimeters enter/leave regions needing different cooling (e.g. overhangs). Longer = smoother fan ramps, fewer surface marks; shorter = more responsive overhang cooling. 10 mm default.

activate_air_filtration.label: Activate air filtration
activate_air_filtration.description: Per-filament switch for chamber exhaust/air filtration during printing. Enable for fume-emitting materials (ABS, ASA); off for PLA-types where exhaust airflow cools the chamber. Fan level via during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.

during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.description: Exhaust/air-filtration fan speed (%) while printing; overrides speeds set in filament custom G-code. Raise to extract fumes (ABS/ASA); high values drop chamber temperature, so keep low for warp-prone high-temp materials. Default 60.

complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.description: Exhaust fan speed, percent, run after the print finishes to purge chamber fumes. Higher clears VOCs faster; mainly for ABS/ASA and other fume-heavy materials. Needs air filtration hardware. 80 typical.

close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.label: For the first
close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.description: Number of initial layers with the auxiliary cooling fan forced off. Protects first-layer adhesion and reduces warping at the base. 1-3 typical; raise for warp-prone materials.

additional_fan_full_speed_layer.label: Full fan speed at layer
additional_fan_full_speed_layer.description: Layer index at which the auxiliary cooling fan reaches its configured speed; below it the fan ramps up or stays off to protect first-layer adhesion. 0 disables the delay. Works alongside close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.

close_fan_the_first_x_layers.label: For the first
close_fan_the_first_x_layers.description: Number of initial layers with the part cooling fan forced off. Ensures hot, well-bonded first layers on the bed; too many fanless layers can hurt small overhangs near the base. 1 typical for PLA, 3+ for ABS/ASA.

first_x_layer_part_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
first_x_layer_part_fan_speed.description: Part cooling fan speed in % during the initial layers; window set by close_fan_the_first_x_layers. 0 disables part cooling there, improving bed adhesion; raise only for severe overhangs starting at layer 1. Per-filament.

first_x_layer_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
first_x_layer_fan_speed.description: Auxiliary (chamber-side) cooling fan speed in % applied only during the initial layers. Keep at 0 so early layers cool slowly and bond to the bed. Per-filament vector.

filament_end_gcode.label: End G-code
filament_end_gcode.description: G-code emitted when this filament is unloaded or its use ends (per-filament, runs at tool change and print end). Typical uses: reset temperatures, fans, or material-specific machine state. Runs before the next filament's start G-code.

filament_flow_ratio.label: Flow ratio
filament_flow_ratio.description: Extrusion multiplier applied to all moves with this filament. Raise for gaps/under-extrusion, lower for blobs, bulging seams, rough top surfaces. Calibrate per material; typical 0.92-1.02 (PLA ~0.98, PETG ~0.95). Max 2.

enable_pressure_advance.label: Enable pressure advance
enable_pressure_advance.description: Applies the filament's pressure_advance value (linear advance). Sharper corners, less bulge/gap at speed transitions. Manual value replaces the printer's automatic flow-dynamics calibration; calibrate per filament first.

pressure_advance.label: Pressure advance
pressure_advance.description: Pressure advance coefficient for nozzle pressure lag: cuts corner bulge, seam blobs, gaps after travels. Typical 0.02-0.06 direct drive, higher for bowden or flexibles. Only active when pressure advance is enabled; calibrate per filament.

filament_notes.label: Filament notes
filament_notes.description: Free-text notes stored with the filament profile. No effect on slicing. Use for calibration results (flow, K-factor), drying history, vendor batch info.

reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.label: Keep fan always on
reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.description: Keeps the part-cooling fan spinning at low speed instead of fully stopping during brief fan-off spans. Avoids on/off cycling whose spin-up lag cools unevenly. Off for warp-prone materials needing zero fan.

fan_cooling_layer_time.label: Layer time
fan_cooling_layer_time.description: Layer-time threshold (s) for cooling control: layers faster than this get fan speed interpolated from fan_min_speed up toward fan_max_speed; slower layers stay at fan_min_speed. Larger value = fan ramps up on more layers. Default 60.

default_filament_colour.label: Default color
default_filament_colour.description: Display color assigned to this filament in the UI and multi-color previews (hex string). Cosmetic and for AMS slot matching; no effect on toolpaths.

required_nozzle_HRC.label: Required nozzle HRC
required_nozzle_HRC.description: Minimum nozzle hardness (Rockwell C) the filament demands, per filament. Nonzero for abrasives (carbon/glass fiber, glow) so the slicer can warn when the installed nozzle is softer, e.g. brass ~HRC 20 vs hardened steel ~HRC 55+. 0 = no requirement.

filament_flush_temp.label: Flush temperature
filament_flush_temp.description: Nozzle temperature (C) used while flushing this filament on the prime/wipe tower during color change. 0 = use normal print temperature. Lower can reduce stringing of oozy materials; must stay high enough to keep flow reliable.

filament_flush_volumetric_speed.label: Flush volumetric speed
filament_flush_volumetric_speed.description: Volumetric rate (mm3/s) for purging this filament during flush on the wipe tower. 0 = use filament max volumetric speed. Lower if flushing causes grinding or clicking; higher shortens multi-color change time.

filament_max_volumetric_speed.label: Max volumetric speed
filament_max_volumetric_speed.description: Hard cap on extrusion flow (mm3/s); slicer slows any move that would exceed it. Primary speed limiter per material: too high causes under-extrusion at speed, too low wastes time. Typical: PLA 12-21, PETG 8-14, TPU 3-6, high-flow higher.

filament_ramming_volumetric_speed.label: Extruder change
filament_ramming_volumetric_speed.description: Extrusion rate (mm3/s) for ramming before an extruder change: rapid push shaping a clean filament tip prior to retraction. -1 = automatic (derived from max volumetric speed). Too high grinds filament; too low leaves stringy tips.

filament_ramming_volumetric_speed_nc.label: Hotend change
filament_ramming_volumetric_speed_nc.description: Extrusion rate (mm3/s) for ramming before a hotend change on dual-nozzle machines. Shapes the filament tip so the retiring hotend retracts cleanly. -1 = automatic from max volumetric speed. Lower if ramming skips or grinds.

filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower.label: Minimal purge on wipe tower
filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower.description: Minimum volume (mm3) purged on the wipe tower when switching TO this filament, regardless of computed flush volume. Guards against undersized flush matrices leaving old color/material in the nozzle. Default 15.

filament_diameter.label: Diameter
filament_diameter.description: Nominal filament diameter (mm) used to convert extrusion lengths to volume. Wrong value scales all extrusion: too small causes over-extrusion, too large under-extrusion. Measure stock if flow is off. Standard 1.75; some machines 2.85.

filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.label: Adaptive volumetric speed
filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.description: Limits extrusion flow to the smaller of a fitted value (from line width and layer height via the volumetric speed coefficients) and the fixed max volumetric speed. Off: fixed max only. Evens quality across mixed line widths.

volumetric_speed_coefficients.label: Max volumetric speed multinomial coefficients
volumetric_speed_coefficients.description: Per-filament polynomial coefficients modeling max volumetric flow as a function of nozzle temperature. Filled automatically by flow-dynamics calibration; leave empty to use the flat filament_max_volumetric_speed limit. Not hand-edited.

filament_shrink.label: Shrinkage
filament_shrink.description: Material shrinkage compensation (%). 100 = no shrinkage; below 100 the slicer scales XY up so cooled parts hit nominal size (e.g. ABS ~99.5, ASA/PA lower). Measure a calibration cube to derive. Affects dimensional accuracy only.

filament_velocity_adaptation_factor.label: Velocity Adaptation Factor
filament_velocity_adaptation_factor.description: Scales how aggressively print velocity adapts for this filament when speed-modulating features engage. 1 = default; lower damps speed changes for materials sensitive to flow transients (TPU, CF-filled).

filament_adhesiveness_category.label: Adhesiveness Category
filament_adhesiveness_category.description: Developer field: integer class describing how the filament bonds to other materials. Consulted for multi-material pairing decisions such as support/interface suitability. Vendor-set; not user-tuned.

filament_metal_stickiness.label: Metal stickiness
filament_metal_stickiness.description: Stickiness class of a metal-fill material (None/Low/Medium/High), used to adapt handling of tacky metal-loaded filaments. Leave None for ordinary polymers.

filament_density.label: Density
filament_density.description: Material density in g/cm3. Used for weight and cost estimates in the slice summary; no effect on toolpaths. Typical: PLA ~1.24, PETG ~1.27, ABS ~1.04.

filament_type.label: Type
filament_type.description: Material class string (PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, PA, PC, PVA...). Drives compatibility checks, flush volume matrix, drying and chamber logic, and default limits. Must match the actual material; not just a label.

filament_soluble.label: Soluble material
filament_soluble.description: Marks this filament as dissolvable (PVA, BVOH). Slicer treats it as preferred support/interface material and allows zero interface gaps since it washes out instead of breaking away. Store dry; highly hygroscopic.

filament_scarf_seam_type.label: Scarf seam type
filament_scarf_seam_type.description: Filament-level scarf seam preference: 'none' keeps ordinary seams, 'external' applies scarf joints to visible outer walls only, 'all' to every wall. Scarf seams ramp the seam over a distance to hide it; effective on glossy materials where seam bumps show most.

filament_scarf_length.label: Scarf length
filament_scarf_length.description: Length (mm) of the scarf joint seam ramp for this filament when scarf seams are enabled. Longer spreads the seam transition, hiding it better on glossy materials; shorter keeps the seam compact. Default 10.

filament_change_length.label: Extruder change
filament_change_length.description: Filament length (mm) extruded from the outgoing extruder during an extruder change to relieve melt pressure and reduce oozing before the swap. Dual-extruder machines. Default 10; raise if change points leave strings or blobs.

filament_change_length_nc.label: Hotend change
filament_change_length_nc.description: Filament length (mm) extruded from the outgoing nozzle during a hotend change, so the parked hotend oozes less. Hotend-swap counterpart of filament_change_length. Default 10 mm.

filament_is_support.label: Support material
filament_is_support.description: Marks this filament as dedicated support material (e.g. Bambu Support W/G, PVA). Slicer then prefers it for support interfaces/body and excludes it from model walls. Enables clean separation without tuning interface gaps.

filament_printable.label: Filament printable
filament_printable.description: Bitmask of extruders allowed to print this filament on multi-extruder machines: bit N set = extruder index N permitted; 3 = both. Restrict when a material needs a specific hotend, e.g. hardened nozzle for CF-filled.

filament_extruder_compatibility.label: Filament-extruder compatibility
filament_extruder_compatibility.description: Restricts which extruder may print this filament on dual-extruder machines (H2D-class). Encoded as int: 0 = no restriction, otherwise limits assignment to the compatible unit, e.g. abrasive or high-temp materials on the hardened side.

filament_prime_volume.label: Filament change
filament_prime_volume.description: Volume (mm3) primed on the wipe tower after a filament change to restore steady flow before printing resumes. Raise if first extrusions after a swap are thin or discolored; lower to save material. Default 45.

filament_prime_volume_nc.label: Hotend change
filament_prime_volume_nc.description: Volume (mm3) primed on the wipe tower after a hotend change (dual-nozzle machines) before the incoming nozzle prints on the model. More than a plain filament change since the whole melt zone restarts. Default 60.

filament_preheat_temperature_delta.label: Preheat temperature delta
filament_preheat_temperature_delta.description: Offset (C) applied when preheating this filament's nozzle ahead of a toolchange on dual-extruder machines. Negative holds the waiting nozzle cooler to limit ooze/degradation; 0 preheats straight to print temperature.

filament_cooling_before_tower.label: Wipe tower cooling
filament_cooling_before_tower.description: Nozzle temperature drop (deg C) allowed before printing on the prime tower after a filament change; cooler entry reduces sag and stringing of purged material. Developer-mode, per filament, default 10.

filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.label: Interface layer pre-extrusion distance
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.description: Travel distance (mm) covered while pre-extruding before printing a prime tower interface layer with this filament. Spreads the priming line so flow is stable when the interface starts. Works with the pre-extrusion length. Default 10.

filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.label: Interface layer pre-extrusion length
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.description: Filament length (mm) pre-extruded before a prime tower interface layer. Primes the nozzle so the interface bonds instead of starting under-extruded; helps towers mixing very different-viscosity materials. 0 disables.

filament_tower_ironing_area.label: Tower ironing area
filament_tower_ironing_area.description: Ironing area (mm2) applied on prime tower surfaces for this filament. Flattens the tower top so the next material bonds and the tower stays stable. 0 disables flat ironing (line ironing may remain), improving stability for some materials.

filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.label: Interface layer purge length
filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.description: Purge volume (mm3) flushed when printing a prime tower interface layer with this filament. Ensures the interface is pure material for reliable adhesion between tower sections. Default 20; raise if interfaces delaminate.

filament_tower_interface_print_temp.label: Interface layer print temperature
filament_tower_interface_print_temp.description: Nozzle temperature (C) for printing prime tower interface layers with this filament. -1 = use normal print temperature. Dedicated interface temp improves layer bonding between dissimilar materials and reduces tower collapse.

temperature_vitrification.label: Softening temperature
temperature_vitrification.description: Softening (glass transition) temperature (deg C) of the filament. Informational limit: parts deform above it, spools in a hot chamber or AMS can soften and jam. Drives chamber-temperature warnings, not a print control.

filament_ramming_travel_time.label: Extruder change
filament_ramming_travel_time.description: Travel dwell (s) after ramming, before an extruder change, letting the filament tip ooze away from the print. 0 disables. Values >0 force wipe-tower ramming line spacing to 2x line width to absorb the overflow. Dual-extruder machines.

filament_ramming_travel_time_nc.label: Hotend change
filament_ramming_travel_time_nc.description: Travel dwell (s) after ramming, before a hotend change, giving the retiring nozzle time to ooze off the model. 0 disables. Values >0 widen wipe-tower ramming line spacing to 2x line width. Dual-nozzle machines.

filament_pre_cooling_temperature.label: Extruder change
filament_pre_cooling_temperature.description: Target nozzle temperature (C) to start cooling toward during ramming before an extruder change (dual-extruder machines). Issues cool command plus fan only; target not guaranteed. 0 disables. Reduces ooze from the parked tool.

filament_pre_cooling_temperature_nc.label: Hotend change
filament_pre_cooling_temperature_nc.description: Target nozzle temperature (C) to start cooling toward during ramming before a hotend change (dual-nozzle machines). Cooling command plus fan only; target may not be reached before the switch. 0 disables. Cuts ooze from the idle hotend.

filament_cost.label: Price
filament_cost.description: Filament price per kilogram. Feeds only the cost estimate shown after slicing; no effect on toolpaths or print behavior.

filament_vendor.label: Vendor
filament_vendor.description: Manufacturer name stored in the profile. Identification/metadata only; no slicing effect. Used for profile organization and matching to vendor presets.

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.label: Initial layer
nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.description: Nozzle temperature (°C) for the first layer only. A common tuning pattern raises it slightly above other layers for bed adhesion; default equals the other-layer temp. Works with bed temperature and first-layer speed.

full_fan_speed_layer.label: Full fan speed at layer
full_fan_speed_layer.description: Layer at which part cooling fan reaches its target speed; ramps linearly from zero starting after the close_fan_the_first_x_layers window. If set at or below that window, fan jumps straight to full speed. 0 disables the ramp.

inherits.label: Inherits profile
inherits.description: Name of the parent system preset this profile derives from. Profile stores only keys that differ; unset keys follow the parent, including after parent updates. Empty means a standalone full profile.

fan_max_speed.label: Fan speed
fan_max_speed.description: Part-cooling fan ceiling (%) applied as layer times approach zero; interpolation target above fan_min_speed per fan_cooling_layer_time. High (80-100) for PLA/PETG detail; low for ABS/ASA to protect layer bonding. Per filament.

fan_min_speed.label: Fan speed
fan_min_speed.description: Baseline part-cooling fan speed (%) used on layers longer than fan_cooling_layer_time; effectively the filament's always-on fan level. Moderate for PLA; near 0 for warp-prone ABS/ASA/PC. Per filament.

additional_cooling_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
additional_cooling_fan_speed.description: Auxiliary (side) part cooling fan speed, percent. Bulk airflow beyond the hotend fan; helps high-speed PLA/PETG cooling and small features. Keep 0 for warp-prone materials (ABS/ASA/PA) needing a warm chamber. Per-filament.

slow_down_min_speed.label: Min print speed
slow_down_min_speed.description: Speed floor (mm/s) for cooling slowdown, per filament. Layer-time slowdown never drops below this, preventing crawl speeds that cause heat soak, blobbing, and nozzle dwell marks. Default 10 mm/s; raise for heat-sensitive materials like PETG.

long_retractions_when_ec.label: Long retraction when extruder change
long_retractions_when_ec.description: Enables an extra-long retraction when the extruder/filament changes, pulling filament far back to cut oozing and cross-contamination during the swap. Slightly slows changes; grinding risk with soft filaments. Per-filament vector; nil falls back to defaults.

retraction_distances_when_ec.label: Retraction distance when extruder change
retraction_distances_when_ec.description: Retraction length (mm) when this filament is parked during an extruder change, per filament. Longer pulls filament further from the melt zone — less ooze while idle, but jam/slow-reprime risk if excessive. Multi-extruder machines only.

filament_extruder_variant.description: Names the extruder/hotend hardware variant each vector entry of this filament profile targets (e.g. Direct Drive Standard). Selects which variant-specific values apply; informational for matching, not a print-quality lever.

filament_retract_length_nc.label: length when change hotend
filament_retract_length_nc.description: Retraction length (mm) pulled when this filament's hotend is deactivated during a hotend change. Longer clears the melt zone and stops ooze from the parked nozzle; too long risks jams on re-engage. Range 0-18, default 10.

slow_down_layer_time.label: Layer time
slow_down_layer_time.description: Target minimum layer time (s), per filament. Faster layers get slowed (floor: slow_down_min_speed) so plastic cools before being covered. Higher = better small-feature quality, slower prints. PLA ~4-8 s; low for high-temp materials.

filament_start_gcode.label: Start G-code
filament_start_gcode.description: G-code emitted when this filament becomes active (print start or tool change, before printing with it). Typical uses: set pressure advance/K-factor, material-specific fans or temperatures. Runs after the previous filament's end G-code.

chamber_temperatures.label: Chamber temperature
chamber_temperatures.description: Target chamber temperature, C (0-80, 0 = uncontrolled). Warm chamber cuts warping and boosts layer adhesion for ABS/ASA/PA/PC; keep 0 for PLA/PETG to avoid heat creep. Only honored by printers with chamber control.

nozzle_temperature.label: Other layers
nozzle_temperature.description: Nozzle temperature (°C) for all layers after the first. Higher improves layer bonding and flow at speed but increases stringing and sag; lower sharpens detail, risks underextrusion. Stay within the filament's stated temp range.

nozzle_temperature_range_low.label: Min
nozzle_temperature_range_low.description: Lower bound (°C) of the filament's usable nozzle temperature range. Slicer warns when configured nozzle temps fall below it. Printing under it risks underextrusion, poor layer bonding, extruder skipping.

nozzle_temperature_range_high.label: Max
nozzle_temperature_range_high.description: Upper bound (°C) of the filament's usable nozzle temperature range. Slicer warns when configured nozzle temps exceed it. Set from manufacturer spec; printing above risks degradation, stringing, heat creep.

impact_strength_z.label: Impact Strength Z
impact_strength_z.description: Filament mechanical-property value for Z-direction (interlayer) impact strength. Development-mode metadata consumed by strength-related features; does not alter sliced geometry. Per-filament.

circle_compensation_speed.label: Circle Compensation Speed
circle_compensation_speed.description: Calibration reference speed, mm/s, the circular contour compensation model assumes for this filament; does not command actual print speed. Change only when recalibrating compensation coefficients with new test prints.

counter_coef_1.label: Counter Coef 1
counter_coef_1.description: Circular compensation: constant term of the polynomial that predicts inner-hole (counter) diameter shrinkage for this filament. Calibrated per material; edit only with measured hole-test data.

counter_coef_2.label: Contour Coef 2
counter_coef_2.description: Circular compensation: linear term of the inner-hole diameter compensation polynomial for this filament. Scales correction with hole diameter. Calibrated value; change only from hole-test measurements.

counter_coef_3.label: Contour Coef 3
counter_coef_3.description: Circular compensation: additional polynomial term of the inner-hole diameter correction model for this filament. Calibrated per material from test prints.

hole_coef_1.label: Hole Coef 1
hole_coef_1.description: Speed term of auto circular-hole compensation: hole offset = coef1*circle_compensation_speed + coef2*diameter + coef3, clamped by hole_limit_min/max. Active only with enable_circle_compensation on supported filaments. Per-filament.

hole_coef_2.label: Hole Coef 2
hole_coef_2.description: Diameter term of auto circular-hole compensation; mm of offset per mm of hole diameter in offset = coef1*speed + coef2*diameter + coef3. Negative default (-0.025) tapers enlargement for bigger holes. Per-filament.

hole_coef_3.label: Hole Coef 3
hole_coef_3.description: Constant term in mm of auto circular-hole compensation formula coef1*speed + coef2*diameter + coef3. Sets the base enlargement applied to detected circular holes. Default 0.28. Per-filament.

counter_limit_min.label: Contour limit min
counter_limit_min.description: Lower clamp, mm, on the automatic inner-hole/contour diameter correction. Prevents the compensation polynomial from over-shrinking features; negative values allow slight reduction.

counter_limit_max.label: Contour limit max
counter_limit_max.description: Upper clamp, mm, on the automatic inner-hole/contour diameter correction. Prevents the compensation polynomial from over-enlarging features on out-of-range diameters.

hole_limit_min.label: Hole limit min
hole_limit_min.description: Lower clamp in mm on the computed circular-hole enlargement from the hole_coef formula. Guarantees a minimum widening so holes never print undersized when compensation is active. Default 0.08. Per-filament.

hole_limit_max.label: Hole limit max
hole_limit_max.description: Upper clamp in mm on the computed circular-hole enlargement from the hole_coef formula. Prevents over-widening small holes. Default 0.25. Per-filament.

diameter_limit.label: Diameter limit
diameter_limit.description: Per-filament upper bound (mm) for auto circle contour-hole compensation: circular holes/contours above this diameter are left uncorrected. Acts with enable_circle_compensation and the hole limit values. Default 50.

filament_dev_ams_drying_ams_limitations.description: Developer metadata: free-form note on AMS model restrictions for this filament's drying profile, consumed by the AMS drying feature. Usually empty; no effect on slicing.

filament_dev_ams_drying_temperature.description: Developer metadata: recommended AMS drying temperature (deg C) for this filament, consumed by the AMS drying feature. 0 = unset; no effect on slicing output.

filament_dev_ams_drying_time.description: Developer metadata: recommended AMS drying duration for this filament, paired with filament_dev_ams_drying_temperature. 0 = unset; no effect on slicing output.

filament_dev_ams_drying_heat_distortion_.description: Developer metadata: heat-distortion temperature (deg C) of the filament/spool, used as a safety ceiling when AMS drying selects temperatures. 0 = unset; no effect on toolpaths.

filament_dev_chamber_drying_bed_temperat.description: Heatbed temperature (C) for the in-chamber filament drying routine. Higher dries faster but must stay safe for the material; 0 disables. Developer-level setting; pair with filament_dev_chamber_drying_time.

filament_dev_chamber_drying_time.description: Duration of the in-chamber filament drying routine. Longer removes more moisture; hygroscopic materials (PA, PC, TPU) need extended runs. Developer-level setting used with filament_dev_chamber_drying_bed_temperature.

filament_dev_drying_softening_temperatur.description: Material softening temperature (C). Upper safety bound during chamber drying and pre-feed checks: if chamber exceeds it, cooling runs before feeding to avoid soft-filament jams. Set below the temperature where the filament deforms.

filament_dev_drying_cooling_temperature.description: Chamber temperature (C) the printer cools down to after a drying cycle before printing resumes. Prevents feeding filament through an overheated chamber. Developer-level setting; 0 leaves cooldown unmanaged.

override_process_overhang_speed.label: Override overhang speed
override_process_overhang_speed.description: Lets this filament impose its own overhang speeds instead of the process profile's. Useful for materials needing distinct overhang handling (e.g. TPU, high-temp filaments); off, process overhang speeds apply.

filament_retraction_length.label: Length
filament_retraction_length.description: Per-extruder override of the printer profile's retraction length (mm) for this filament; a 'nil' element keeps the printer value. Flexible and oozy materials often need more than the printer default; direct-drive typically 0.4-1.2 mm, bowden 2-6 mm.

filament_z_hop.label: Z hop when retract
filament_z_hop.description: Per-extruder override of the printer's Z hop height (mm, 0-5) during retracted travel for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Raising it fights stringing-prone materials dragging across the part; costs travel time.

filament_z_hop_types.label: Z Hop Type
filament_z_hop_types.description: Per-extruder override of the printer's Z hop trajectory for this filament ('Auto Lift', 'Normal Lift', 'Slope Lift', 'Spiral Lift'); 'nil' keeps the printer value. Slope/Spiral reduce stringing and ooze marks on sticky materials by moving diagonally while lifting.

filament_retraction_speed.label: Retraction Speed
filament_retraction_speed.description: Per-extruder override of the printer's retraction speed (mm/s) for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Soft filaments (TPU) need slower retracts to avoid stretching and grinding; rigid materials tolerate fast retracts.

filament_deretraction_speed.label: Deretraction Speed
filament_deretraction_speed.description: Per-extruder override of the speed for re-priming after retraction (mm/s) for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer value, 0 means use retraction speed. Slower deretraction helps materials that swell in the melt zone re-prime without blobs.

filament_retract_restart_extra.label: Extra length on restart
filament_retract_restart_extra.description: Per-extruder override of extra filament (mm) extruded when restarting after retraction; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Positive compensates ooze losses on leaky materials; negative counters blobbing. Keep within a few tenths of a millimeter.

filament_retraction_minimum_travel.label: Travel distance threshold
filament_retraction_minimum_travel.description: Per-extruder override of the minimum travel distance (mm) that triggers a retraction for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Raise for materials where frequent retracts cause grinding; lower for stringy materials needing retracts even on short hops.

filament_wipe_distance.label: Wipe Distance
filament_wipe_distance.description: Per-extruder override of the nozzle wipe distance (mm) for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Longer wipes shear off ooze from stringy materials before travel; too long scars the surface at the seam.

filament_retract_when_changing_layer.label: Retract when change layer
filament_retract_when_changing_layer.description: Per-extruder override: force a retraction on layer change for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer setting. Enable for materials that leave layer-change blobs; disable to save time with well-behaved filaments.

filament_wipe.label: Wipe while retracting
filament_wipe.description: Per-extruder override: wipe the nozzle along the last path while retracting for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer setting. Effective against ooze marks with PETG and other tacky materials.

filament_retract_before_wipe.label: Retract amount before wipe
filament_retract_before_wipe.description: Per-extruder override of how much of the retraction (percent) happens before the wipe move for this filament; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Higher values reduce material available to smear during the wipe; 100% retracts fully first.

filament_long_retractions_when_cut.label: Long retraction when cut(experimental)
filament_long_retractions_when_cut.description: Experimental, per-extruder override: pull the filament far back when the cutter severs it (multi-material), reducing degraded material left in the melt zone; 'nil' keeps the printer setting. Only for materials that tolerate re-melting after long dwell.

filament_retraction_distances_when_cut.label: Retraction distance when cut
filament_retraction_distances_when_cut.description: Per-extruder override of the long-retraction distance (10-18 mm) used when the filament is cut; 'nil' keeps the printer value. Must clear the melt zone without pulling soft filament into the extruder gears.

filament_enable_overhang_speed.label: Slow down for overhang
filament_enable_overhang_speed.description: Per-extruder override: apply overhang-ratio-based speed reduction for this filament; 'nil' keeps the process setting. Disable only for materials whose overhang quality is insensitive to speed (some engineering blends) to save time.

filament_bridge_speed.label: Bridge
filament_bridge_speed.description: Per-extruder override of bridge printing speed (mm/s) for this filament; 'nil' keeps the process value. Materials with poor bridging (PETG) want slower bridges with strong cooling; PLA tolerates faster. Typical 20-40 mm/s.

filament_overhang_1_4_speed.description: Per-extruder override of print speed (mm/s) for lines overhanging up to 25% of their width; 'nil' or 0 keeps the process value. First tier of the four-step overhang slowdown ladder for this filament.

filament_overhang_2_4_speed.description: Per-extruder override of print speed (mm/s) for 25-50% overhanging lines; 'nil' or 0 keeps the process value. Second tier of the overhang slowdown ladder for this filament.

filament_overhang_3_4_speed.description: Per-extruder override of print speed (mm/s) for 50-75% overhanging lines; 'nil' or 0 keeps the process value. Third tier; heat-sensitive materials benefit most from slowing here.

filament_overhang_4_4_speed.description: Per-extruder override of print speed (mm/s) for 75-100% overhanging lines; 'nil' or 0 keeps the process value. Steepest supported overhangs; slowest tier before bridging rules apply.

filament_overhang_totally_speed.description: Per-extruder override of print speed (mm/s) for fully unsupported (100% overhang) lines; 'nil' keeps the process value. Effectively near-bridge printing; keep slow (default 10) with maximum cooling.
